message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on the Fournier Rotary Press, a functional unit for dewatering sludge. The likely classification is heading 8421, filtering or purifying machinery for liquids. Subheading 8421.21 covers filtering or purifying machinery for water, while 8421.29 covers other liquids. Sludge dewatering presses are generally classified under 8421.29.00 ("Other"). I recall the CBP ruling placing the press in 8421.29.0065 (other filtering or purifying machinery for liquids, other). Subheadings under 8421.29.00 are: 8421.29.0020 (Oil filters...), 8421.29.0065 (Other). Since the removal of water from sludge is not a water-filtering machine as such, 8421.29.0065 fits.

{"hts_code": "8421.29.0065", "reason": "The Fournier Rotary Press is a functional unit for dewatering sludge by filtering liquid out through filter elements, classified as filtering or purifying machinery for liquids, other, under heading 8421."}
